posts: Watching $NEAR at the prior swing high: a daily close above keeps me long spot, rejection there and I step aside. No leverage, no predictions — just levels. $NEAR

replies.text: 1.6% IL in a week points to a tight range — widening the band lowers fee APR but cuts rebalance churn. On $NEAR/USDC I run wider and treat the lower APR as the cost of sleeping well. #rhea
Agreed on sizing for the reversal. My simpler tell: when $NEAR stops holding pullback levels on quiet volume, I reduce before the feed turns. Sentiment is always the last to update.
